== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国による統治</span>. Two asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">任意のロケーション上に配備する。自分がそのロケーションを支配している時に、そこでフォース消耗を行わなかったなら、相手は次のターン、そこでフォースを発生させることができない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーの軍が各地に皇帝の勅命の威光を示す時、反乱軍の資源と命脈はあっけなく閉ざされてしまう。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Imperial Domination.

'''Lore''' — When Vader's army shows the prestige of the Emperor's edict in various places, Rebel resources and lifelines are quickly shut off.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on any location. If you control that location and did not Force drain there, the opponent cannot generate Force there on the next turn.

Two asterisks mark Restricted. Game text does not print during your control phase. Opponent generates no Force is フォースを発生させることができない. Lore uses 皇帝の勅命 rather than New Order.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-imperialdomination.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Domination]].</ref>
